title: sabulina douglasii
intro: Sabulina douglasii, commonly known as Douglas' sandwort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. It is a succulent perennial that is native to North America, known for its ability to thrive in arid and sandy environments. The health benefits of Sabulina douglasii include its potential to aid in wound healing and skin protection due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
